_comment: Cloudreach Fly. Installed Galecrest is the replaceable traversal presentation. An owned healthy active carrier is preferred; Maela's story loaner guarantees the chapter cannot deadlock a valid full five-creature Meadows team and never becomes owned or consumes a party slot. Second Jump (A) airborne deploys; hold A in marked updrafts to climb; hold LT/C to descend. Outside authored currents flight only descends.

hang_pose._why_on: ON 11 Nov 2026 (F38#8 P2-119, GPU High, G-newapproach-fly-grip on tb/item-scout-1108 88b1dc8ba): elbow bend (upper_lateral 0.8 -> 2.2, forearm_lateral 0.65 -> -0.25) plus hang_pose.body, base 6.26 -> 7.14 mapped (+0.88, 3/3 prefer), recorded defect PRESENT -> PARTIAL. Judges' note for a later close-out: the arms still run straight up to the talons, with no lean or swing.

body._why: P2-119 (UIPOSES lane, 1 Nov 2026). GPU item scores 28 Oct: 6.12, the trainer hangs rigidly upright beneath Galecrest with dangling legs, reading as a ladder hang. When enabled the legs trail back with bent knees (one trailing further) and the torso leans into the flight (trainer_model.gd fly_hang_body_rotations); the arms still aim at the grip points. Presentation only; no collider, camera, stamina or network change. ON since 11 Nov (see hang_pose._why_on).

landing_presentation._why_side_1112: 12 Nov 2026 (LANE-THINGS, GPU High, G-galeland2.md on tb/item-scout-1108 244c8064): 1.2 -> 2.3 so the landed carrier stands beside the trainer instead of overlapping them. Galewisp landed 6.34 -> 8.11 (3/3), Galewisp flight 6.43 -> 7.29, Galecrest control 6.88 -> 7.43; nothing loses. forward_m stays 2.4 (1.2 cropped the ear tufts).
landing_presentation._why_wing_fold_on: CPU 5.99 -> 6.33 (VIS-MEADOWS r1b, 4 Nov 2026: F38#15 P2-069 flight and landing pose read; three code-blind judges, calibrated slope 1.16 r 0.90 RMSE 0.53; ralph/reports/LANES/VIS-MEADOWS/r1b/VERDICT.md). The landing frame now reads as a folded-wing perch (2 of 3 judges FIXED). Owner 4 Nov: a judged gain ships ON.
landing_presentation._why_wing_fold: P2-069 (UIPOSES lane, 1 Nov 2026). GPU item score 28 Oct 5.88: the bird lands still wings-up in its flight silhouette, so the descent-to-rest change reads as a cut. When enabled, a capability with landing_fold_offsets folds its wings along the body over the landing settle (fly_landing_presentation.gd, post_stance.gd). Offsets measured on the Galecrest rig in an isolated render. Presentation only; OFF until GPU judging.

mentor_loaner._why_ends_at_flag: General loaner traversal ends with the chapter. Owner 13 Oct: retain only authored Master-perch transport; owned carriers remain unrestricted by this exception.

landing_anchor._comment: Stage B lane 6.C. Where a CLIENT is allowed to put its feet down, as MP_ENCOUNTER_PROTOCOL.md Sec2 requires: the host holds the authoritative position, so a client proposes an anchor and the host answers with one off its own ground. scripts/net/fly_anchor_arbiter.gd holds the rule; these are its tolerances. Solo and the host are untouched -- there is no second process with an opinion to reconcile. All TUNABLE.

galecrest._why_presentation_height: F38#15 mount scale (VIS-MEADOWS, coordinator-approved presentation only, 4 Nov 2026): CPU 6.21 -> 7.08 (+0.87; all three judges prefer it; the landed bird now stands taller than the 1.80 m trainer; quick_judge f38_15-mount-scale, slope 1.53 r 0.91 RMSE 0.51). Grows the carrier art only; collision_height_m, feet_offset and grip alignment are unchanged.

galewisp._why: CREATURES §7: the Galewisp starter gains Fly at the Cloudreach unlock (SYSTEMS Fly target: 'honor Galewisp's starter promise with the same lawful flight capability after unlock'). Before the unlock it does not carry, so Maela's trial keeps her loaner. Its rig has no feet or forearm bones: the lower legs grip the wrists and the upper wing aims at the tip. height_m scales Galecrest's 2.1 m carrier by the two species' world heights (3.25 / 3.5), still above the 1.80 m trainer.
galewisp._why_model: 12 Nov 2026 (LANE-THINGS): the carrier still named the pre-remake mesh, so Galewisp flew as the old cartoon fox-bird while every other view showed the 1 Nov remake (owner: all remakes ON; no mascot). LANE-SCOUT G-faint2-medium-galecarrier.md (tb/item-scout-1108 5f1f5ee2), GPU High: Galewisp in flight 6.17 -> 6.83 (+0.66), 3/3 prefer; the remake reads as a naturalistic owl-griffin, the old mesh as a chibi mascot.
galewisp._why_presentation_height_1112: 3.0 -> 3.4 with the landing side step above (G-galeland2.md, 244c8064). 3.4 is the ceiling: the ear tip sits 1-3 px under the top edge at 1080p.
galewisp._why_presentation_height: F38#15 mount scale (VIS-MEADOWS, coordinator-approved presentation only, 4 Nov 2026): CPU 6.21 -> 7.08 (+0.87; all three judges prefer it; the landed bird now stands taller than the 1.80 m trainer; quick_judge f38_15-mount-scale, slope 1.53 r 0.91 RMSE 0.51). Grows the carrier art only; collision_height_m, feet_offset and grip alignment are unchanged.
galewisp._why_grip_bones: The remake rig has foot bones (the old mesh had none and gripped with its shins), so the trainer hangs from the feet, as with Galecrest.
